profile.name: Michael Thompson
profile.bio: Michael Thompson was first elected to Toronto City Council in 2003 and is now in his sixth term representing Scarborough Centre. Before entering politics he worked as an entrepreneur in the business and financial services sector (after serving as an assistant to Councillor Lorenzo Berardinetti, 1998-2003), and holds a BA in Economics from Concordia University. During the 2022 election he was charged with two counts of sexual assault and stepped down as deputy mayor and Chair of the Economic and Community Development Committee; he pleaded not guilty and was found not guilty on both charges in September 2025. He did not leave office and continues to serve his term.

expensesDetailSource.publisher: City Clerk's Office, City of Toronto
expensesDetailSource.note: Figures are the City's routine disclosure of constituency services and office expenses, shown as published, by category, from 2013. This is a separate publication from the annual remuneration reports in expenses.json, with a narrower scope — office spending only, not pay, benefits or staff salaries — and the two are never added together. Amounts shown as personal funds are the member's own money, as the City reports it. Invoice-level documents stay on the City's site; category amounts link to them.
